page.layout: One column of index entries, left-aligned, with page numbers at the right; the right side is cut off, so the numbers are partly visible. The large initial L at the start of the "Laurentius" entry stands at the left margin.; One column of index entries, each line a name with its page number at the right after dot leaders. Above the column, the running head INDEX with a roman numeral. Nothing printed below the column on this part.; One column of index entries, with a large initial M at the head of the M entries. No running head, catchword or page number on this part.

main_text.l: M. Aurelius Antoninus Bassianus Caracalla Imp. 49

page.notes: Right-hand page numbers are cut off in this part; only their first digits or none are visible, and they are transcribed as far as they show. Entries marked [?] have their final figure or letter unreadable at the scan edge. The left edge carries fragments of numbers and words from the neighbouring page (for example "7", "3", "ti", "ie-") and the right edge a fragment of the next column; these are not printed on this page and are left out. The running head and page numbering are read as printed; the roman numeral at the top right is uncertain and may be a page number or a signature. The last entry continues past the cut and is left as far as it is legible. The large initial M at the head of the Acrianus entry is printed as a separate capital and is shown as a plain M. The word "Scantilla" is hard to read in the scan and is marked [?]. Lines run to the page edge, with the lower part of the page blank.
